summary: Build practical tank, terminal, and pipeline operating skills with API-based exercises. Explore the five-day course and its applied curriculum.
lede: Oil and gas storage and transport training serves intermediate operations, maintenance, integrity, and engineering professionals. They practise mapping asset flows, reconciling custody-measurement data, and prioritizing tank and pipeline inspection risks. Practical exercises also address operating limits, overfill response, SCADA monitoring, and Excel KPI reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate professionals who operate, maintain, inspect, engineer, or oversee oil and gas storage and transportation assets.
modules: ASME B31.4 and B31.8 Pipeline Operations
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with oil and gas operations, maintenance, engineering, measurement, or asset integrity is expected. The course uses intermediate terminology and case information; prior experience with tank farms or pipeline operations will help. No coding is required. Excel-based exercises support the measurement and KPI activities. Advanced digital monitoring and AI-assisted anomaly detection receive conceptual and operational-awareness treatment, not implementation training.
